reuse_IMG2600: evidence/s101/S90-reuse-binding.json and completed S90 10bit statistics; no rerun or 12bit retry
ideal_headroom: (S+original_fullprecision_offset)*exp2(log2(headroom)/3*log2((H+offset)/(S+offset)))-offset; same S89/S90 formula, no encoded-offset substitution

edge_brightness_diagnostics: Unmodified S90 gradient/reference-edge>=4/Laplacian proxies and brightness bins. No invented halo-visibility or per-bin acceptance threshold.
image_archival: None. Reuse existing final HEIC; all decoded arrays/EXR/display images temporary runner scratch, cleanup on success/failure
S105_transport_change: Bounded HTTP206 virtual ZIP, four selected ciphers; cipher SHA and full GPG unchanged. No full200 fallback, whole ZIP SHA not rehashed here. Same S103/S90 numeric body.
